g.text: SOF Linux Kernel Driver Subsystem Architecture
Layered Hierarchy: User Space, ALSA/ASoC Core, SOF Core, IPC Protocols, Platform DSP Ops, and Hardware Buses
TIER 1: LINUX USER SPACE (AUDIO DAEMONS, LIBS & UTILITIES)
TIER 2: LINUX KERNEL ALSA CORE & ASOC (ALSA SYSTEM ON CHIP) FRAMEWORK (sound/core/, sound/soc/)
TIER 3: SOF CORE SUBSYSTEM (sound/soc/sof/snd-sof.ko) — GENERIC AUDIO DSP LOGIC & LIFECYCLE
TIER 4: PROTOCOL DUALITY (IPC3 / IPC4) & AUXILIARY CLIENT FRAMEWORK (sof-client.c)
• Doorbell IRQs: H2D interrupt & D2H reply
• Gateway nodes, Module IDs & Multi-pin routing
• Probes (snd-sof-probes.ko): Real-time DMA firmware trace & data taps
• LLEXT Loader (snd-sof-llext-load.ko): Post-silicon relocatable ELF injection
• Debug Tools: Remote GDB stub (sof-client-fw-gdb) & IPC message injectors
TIER 5: PLATFORM DSP OPERATIONS HOOKS (struct snd_sof_dsp_ops) & SILICON BACKENDS
• Meteor Lake, Arrow Lake, Panther Lake
TIER 6: PHYSICAL BUS INTERCONNECTS & TARGET DSP HARDWARE
• PCIe bus (snd-sof-pci.ko) • ACPI discovery (snd-sof-acpi.ko) • Device Tree (OF)
• SoundWire Link (DISCO tables) • HD-Audio link • SSP/I2S • PDM Microphone array
• DSP Compute Cores: Xtensa LX6 / LX7 / RISC-V with hardware FPU & SIMD DSP engines
• Memory Architecture: High-Performance SRAM, Low-Power SRAM, L2 Cache, DMA FIFOs
